title: scan.rs: parse_begin_line re-parses what is_begin_line already matched
description: uuencoding/src/scan.rs: is_begin_line() checks whether a line starts with 'begin ' and has the right shape. When it returns true, handle_block() then calls parse_begin_line() on the same line, which re-runs essentially the same matching logic to extract mode and filename. This is a double-parse of the same bytes. The fix is to combine the two into one function that returns Option<(mode, filename)> — None means 'not a begin line', Some means 'parsed successfully'. Alternatively, is_begin_line could be replaced entirely with a call to parse_begin_line that returns Option. As-is, a future change to the begin-line format must be applied in both places.
